headline: SoftBank shares fall sharply as calls to slow AI development grow
summary: SoftBank shares fell sharply on Monday as leading AI developers warned that development must be slowed and safety prioritised over profits, weighing on technology sector shares.
why: SoftBank Group is a Japanese conglomerate with large holdings in artificial intelligence and technology companies, so its shares are sensitive to AI sentiment.
why_moved: Calls from leading AI developers to slow development and put safety before profits weighed on technology shares, with SoftBank falling sharply.
